matching: exact entity type and half-open offsets

threshold_selection.caveat: The development subset is drawn from the Nemotron-PII train split, which the model card reports as GLiNER-PII's training data; dev scores are in-sample and likely optimistic. The test split was not read.

configuration_decision.reason: fp32/batch 1 is the library's default precision and exactly the unbatched predict_entities path; fp32 batching gave no speedup on the 4 GB GPU. fp16/batch 4 was 2.2x faster but changed predictions on 69/2,000 dev texts and raised dev gateway F1 by ~0.003 (+33 EMAIL_ADDRESS exact matches), a systematic shift rather than noise, so it was not used. Decided on dev data only.

threshold_selection.rule: maximize development-subset gateway-ontology micro-F1 (strict exact span/type); ties within 0.0001 go to the lower threshold
